title: Who can see that you voted?
hook: Two stated cases: explore the absolute turnout difference in a toy comparison.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the absolute turnout difference in a toy comparison affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Gap, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the absolute turnout difference in a toy comparison in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy comparison has 581/1000 in A and 500/1000 in B. What is A minus B in percentage points?
